title: header format icon: clicking the tune icon opens the Column Formatting dialog with that field pre-selected
verifies: clicking the format (tune) icon in a table column header opens the Column Formatting dialog with the clicked column pre-selected and center controls rendered

title: cancel discards unsaved override changes: re-opening dialog shows empty state
verifies: making formatting changes and clicking Cancel closes the dialog without persisting; re-opening shows the empty state

title: remove an override: delete button clears the column from the override list
verifies: hovering a configured column row reveals a delete button; clicking it removes the override; after save, the override is not persisted

title: empty state: dialog opened from ConfigPanel shows centered Add Field button
verifies: opening the Column Formatting dialog from ConfigPanel without pre-selecting a field renders the centered empty-state Add Field button and no configured column rows; clicking the button opens the dropdown
